keyPoints: Vigyaan me karya tabhi maana jaata hai jab bal lagne par vastu bal ki disha me visthapit ho — W = bal × visthapan.
Karya ka matrak joule (J) hai; 1 joule wo karya hai jo 1 newton bal se vastu ko 1 metre visthapit karne par hota hai.
Urja karya karne ki kshamta hai — gatisheel vastu me gatij urja (1/2 mv²) aur unchai par rakhi vastu me sthitij urja (mgh) hoti hai.
Urja ke kayi roop hain — ushma, prakash, vidhyut, rasayanik aur parmanu urja; ye sab aapas me badal sakte hain.
Urja sanrakshan niyam kehta hai — urja na to banai ja sakti hai na mitai ja sakti hai, sirf ek roop se doosre roop me badalti hai.
Shakti (power) karya karne ki dar hai — P = W/t; iska matrak watt hai aur ghar ka bijli ka bill kilowatt-ghanta (unit) me aata hai.
Aam galti: deewar ko dhakka dene ko karya samajhna; visthapan shoonya hai to vigyaan ke hisab se karya bhi shoonya hai, chahe paseena kitna bhi aaye.

title: Karya aur Urja
